WITH overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(remaining) as mean_remaining FROM budget
),
event_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    budget.link_to_event as event,
    AVG(budget.spent) as avg_spent,
    AVG(budget.remaining) as avg_remaining
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY budget.link_to_event
)
SELECT 
  event,
  avg_spent,
  avg_remaining,
  avg_remaining - (SELECT mean_remaining FROM overall_mean) as difference_from_mean
FROM event_averages
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN avg_remaining - (SELECT mean_remaining FROM overall_mean) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  avg_remaining - (SELECT mean_remaining FROM overall_mean) DESC
LIMIT 10
